DESCRIPTIVE_INFO.KEYWORDS: pet store management system, pet shop software, pet store POS, pet store membership, pet boarding software, pet grooming booking, pet store inventory, pet clinic software
DESCRIPTIVE_INFO.SHORT_DESCRIPTION: MengChong Boss is an all-in-one digital operation system for pet stores. Smart POS, membership marketing, inventory with expiry alerts, grooming appointments, boarding management, business reports, online mall and pet profiles - eight modules in one. Windows client, web and mobile share one data source. Free version ready for business.
DESCRIPTIVE_INFO.LONG_DESCRIPTION: MengChong Boss is an all-in-one digital operation system built for pet stores, covering the full "service + retail + stored value + timing" business model. Eight core modules: smart POS supports product+service mixed billing, barcode scan, member recognition, discounts, hold/unhold orders and e-receipts; membership marketing supports stored value, points, course cards, benefit cards, member levels and tags with birthday & grooming cycle auto reminders; inventory supports batch, expiry FEFO (first-expire-first-out) and near-expiry/stock-out alerts; appointment supports online grooming booking, slot capacity control and auto reminders; boarding supports room registration, feeding check-in, photo daily report and pickup sign-off; business reports provide revenue, profit, sales, member, staff and chain multi-dimension analysis; online mall syncs with store inventory for in-store pickup and same-city delivery; pet profiles keep breed, vaccine, deworming and grooming records. Three-end sync: Windows client, web and mobile share one account and one set of data. Free version ready for business; paid version unlocks full boarding workflow, expiry alerts, marketing growth tools, staff performance and AI weekly report - no bundling, data exportable anytime.
DESCRIPTIVE_INFO.SLOGAN: Run your pet store on one system
